description: This source file defines a test fixture class for integration/functional testing of the Public API in the eShopOnWeb project. It customizes the hosting environment to use in-memory databases suitable for testing scenarios.

classes.name: TestApiApplication
classes.description: A custom WebApplicationFactory for setting up the testing environment with in-memory databases and specific configurations for the Public API tests.
